shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的合规主图

style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and macro, sunny yellow #FFD338 accents, soft cream #FAF3E0 and pale sky panels for scene and trust shots
style.iconSystem: thin rounded line icons, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, gentle directional window light for scene shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids rainwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sunny yellow #FFD338, sky blue #3FA9F5, cherry pink #F5A7C0, charcoal text #333333 and clean white #FFFFFF fields; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; thin rounded line icon style; clean high-key product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright hooded-poncho presentation with hood shaped and visible; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: hooded poncho shown upright with hood shaped, stable slight 3/4 hero angle across the set
style.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep, light wood floor and matte panel boards
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, friendly but not cartoonish
